## ✨ Highlights

- 🎨 **Eighteen palettes, each light and dark**: Janus (the default, as it was), Abysse, and the well-known ones - Ayu, Catppuccin, Dracula, Everforest, Flexoki, GitHub, Gruvbox, Kanagawa, Night Owl, Nightfox, Nord, One, Rosé Pine, Solarized, Tokyo Night, Tomorrow - every one held to WCAG AA. **T** goes to the next one, anywhere.
- 📈 **Charts that move**: a node's charts scroll continuously at a sample a second, their curves never overshooting their samples, a tooltip beside the pointer - and they come back whole from another tab, a time with no sample shaded.
- 🛰️ **The fleet at a glance**: each node's last two minutes - CPU, requests, traffic, a reading every 2 s - on its card, and the nodes as cards or as a list.
- 🔍 **More to read on a node**: segmented gauges, the traffic across the Overview, HAProxy's counters broken down on Metrics - with the **TLS versions and ciphers** its clients use -, particles running along the Traffic flow.

Only the Controller changes: nodes need no update for any of it.

## 🎨 Appearance

- **The palette button** in the top bar - on the node list, every node page and the sign-in screen - chooses the mode (the system's, light or dark) and the palette, from tiles drawn in each palette's own colours. The choice is remembered per browser and followed at once by every open page of the Controller.
- **T** anywhere but in a field takes the next palette, **Shift+T** the previous, its name shown a moment at the foot of the window; the picker turns the shortcut off.
- The well-known palettes keep their makers' colours; where one falls short of AA in the Controller - a status colour on its tint, text on a third surface, an accent under its text -, it's moved in lightness just enough, its hue kept. A test holds every palette, light and dark, to AA, and a status pill lays its tint over the card's colour wherever it sits: a lighter strip under it - a machine's, on the node list - doesn't take its contrast away.
- **Cards**: titles in small capitals over a rule - one that names something, a backend, a file, a version, keeps its case -, figures in JetBrains Mono (shipped with the pages, no font fetched from elsewhere), pills edged in their own colour, two faint glows on the page. The Janus symbol takes the palette's colours.
- 🐛 Janus's dark danger red was 4.23:1 on its tint: it's a shade lighter, and a solid danger button gets its own darker fill (white on it was 3.49:1).

## 📈 Charts

- **They move continuously** while the page samples the node: the time axis scrolls every frame, its right edge a sampling interval behind, so the line grows at the edge instead of jumping a step per sample; the scale eases to a new top.
- **A sample a second, a minute shown** by default (every 5 s and five minutes before): Overview and Metrics share the choice of the time shown - 1, 5 or 15 minutes, or all the history -, remembered per browser. The refresh interval is still chosen in the top bar.
- **Curves that don't lie**: between two samples the line stays between their values - never below zero beside a burst, never above 100 % -, each series over a faint area; a time with no sample (a node rebooting, a tab hidden a long time) is **shaded**, never a line drawn across it.
- **Back from another tab, whole**: a node's page goes on sampling while its tab is hidden - for 15 minutes, then it stops until it shows again -, so a look at another tab leaves no hole.
- 🐛 **They never freeze**: a request that never answered - one sent on a connection that died while the computer slept - stopped the sampling for good, the charts still until the page was reloaded; such a request now gives up after a few intervals and the sampling goes on. And once samples come back after a gap (a node's reboot), the edge jumps to them instead of taking most of a minute to catch up.
- **A tooltip** beside the pointer shows the sample under it, its time and values, riding with it as it scrolls; the legend shows the newest figures and no longer moves.
- Light: a frame moves the curves without drawing them again, and is skipped when nothing moved a quarter of a pixel; nothing moves off screen, in a hidden tab, or under "reduce motion".

## 🖥️ Controller

- **Node list**: each reachable node's card shows its last two minutes of CPU, HAProxy requests and traffic, a reading every 2 s; the Controller goes on sampling ten minutes after the list was last shown, so a list back from another tab has no hole. **Cards / List** beside Add node shows the nodes as rows of a table - state, curves, version, HAProxy, uptime, trust, Open -, remembered per browser.
- **Overview** opens on the node's traffic, across the page, received and sent large in its header, then **gauges** of its CPU, memory and STATE.
- **Metrics**: its six charts three a row, then six rings, three a row: what HAProxy's counters say since it started - its responses by status class, requests by HTTP version, the bytes each backend moved, TLS handshakes (full, resumed, failed) -, and **TLS versions** and **ciphers**, from HAProxy's last log lines (`option httpslog` writes them: [how to log them](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/haproxy-config.md#tls-versions-and-ciphers-on-metrics)); a ring with nothing to show says why. Then how fast each backend answers.
- **Storage** shows a gauge per filesystem the node writes to; a **hypervisor's** card its CPU, memory and pool as gauges.
- **Traffic flow**: particles run along the links where traffic goes, closer and faster the more bytes; the node in the middle is **Janus**.
- **A node page's sidebar** folds into a rail of icons on a wide screen with a mouse, opening over the page under the pointer or the keyboard's focus; **Keep it open** pins it. A touch screen keeps it open, a phone its drawer.
- The **refresh** buttons turn while they refresh, then show a check mark.
- Once the session has ended, a node's page stops asking the node: it says so and offers to sign in again. Its background sampling never kept a session alive.

## 🔌 API

- **`GET /api/nodes/metrics`** (any account, for the nodes it sees): each node's last minutes of CPU busy %, HAProxy requests a second and bytes a second in and out, readings 2 s apart, `?since=` for the newer ones. The Controller samples a node while a page asks for it and ten minutes after, and keeps ten minutes.
- **`GET /nodes/<id>/api/haproxy/tls-log`** (whoever may read the node's logs): the TLS versions and ciphers in HAProxy's last 5000 lines on the node, counted.

## 🧪 Tests and tooling

- `hack/ui-preview.sh` (a Controller and three nodes under traffic, in Docker): published on another address (`UI_PREVIEW_BIND`, `UI_PREVIEW_HOST`), `reload ui`, and `check` - every palette in both modes over the Controller's pages, axe (WCAG 2 A/AA), no error, the shortcut, the motion and the sidebar. Its nodes serve HTTPS with HTTP/2 and some errors, logged with `httpslog`, and a few clients on TLS 1.2 or asking for ChaCha20, so every breakdown shows.
- 📖 [Bringing your haproxy.cfg](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/haproxy-config.md#tls-versions-and-ciphers-on-metrics): what Metrics' TLS versions and ciphers need from the log.
- The docs' screenshots taken again.
